title: Overlay cards over a speaker (5 templates, 16:9 and 9:16)
what_it_does: Writes one transparent card scene for a talking-head video: lower-third (name and role), takeaway (label and sentence), stat (number and meaning), quote, keyword. Every colour and font is a frame.md variable; each card exists for 16:9 and 9:16.
when_to_use: On the beats of the speech: a name when the person first speaks, a number when they say it, a takeaway when they sum up. About one card per 6-8 s at most. Not a replacement for full-screen explainer scenes.

source.assets_licence: The AI Automation Society brand assets of the upstream repo (logo, brand tokens, guideline, example project content) are not licensed and are not included; no AIS colours or fonts remain.

attribution: overlay-cards: adapted from nateherkai/herk-edit-kit style-library/02-kallaway tier-2 cards (MIT, (c) 2026 Nate Herk; Herk Edit Kit Use Permission retained in parts/overlay-cards/PIPELINE-USE-PERMISSION.txt)
notes: Adapted, not verbatim: the anatomy and entrance stagger of the byline, takeaway and metric cards were kept; the markup, sizes, 9:16 layout and all tokens are rewritten. The upstream PIPELINE-USE-PERMISSION notice must travel with the files, so it is installed next to them. The five-template set is deliberately small; the upstream style library has about 120 more. End-to-end proof: catalog/lanes/talking-head/example/run-proof.sh.
